## Med 3-4 Academic Program Committee Meeting Minutes 12/21/2009

|                                                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Student Aftendance Rep                                                                                                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                         |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Arnold, Mark Barin; Kamrin Bartholomew, Deb Bourekas, Eric Bowyer, Brian Clinchot, Dan Cohen; Dan Cronau, Holly Ecklar;, Pat Essig, Garth Harzman, Alan Hasbrouck, Carol Hoyle; Chad Kapoor, Ritu | Khandelwal, Sorabh Kman; Nicholas Ledford, Cindy Letson, Alan Liston; Beth Lynn; Joanne Mcllroy, Mary Muscarella; Pete Niedermier , Julie O'Dorisio; Nathan Pfeil, Sheryl Rose, Stephen Scharschmidt, Thomas Shim; Rosemarie | Bashaw, Hillary Fu; Julia Gerstman, Jacob Ho, Vincent House, Melissa Rose, Maggie Sauers, Lynn Schroeder, Catherine Subbarao; Catherine Tam, Marty Vogt; Keith Voss, Sarah Wolfson; Anna | Presiding Chair:   Mary Mcllroy, MD [Recording Secretary: Sean Bragg Call To Order: 4:07 pm [Adjourned: 5:30 Location: B124 Graves Hall |

## AGENDA

## 1 Opening

- A Approval of Minutes:
- B Announcements:

## Business

## A. CAPS presentation:

## DISCUSSIONS and CONCLUSIONS

November 16, 2009 meeting minutes approved.

- a Dr. Kman new Clerkship Director for DOC-1.
- b Dr. Khandelwal new Assoc Director of Med 3-4.
- C Faculty Development brochure "Teaching for Optimal Patient Care with Electronic Medical Records" printed and available for distribution to dept faculty.

The Clinical Assessment and Problem Solving (CAPS) program representatives gave an overview of their current Med 1-2 curriculum (handout).   They listed some suggestions for how CAPS could function in the 3rd and 4th years, and opened the floor for discussion

## ACTIONS FOLLOW-UP

CAPS will take information gathered and discuss at future APC meetings.   They will return february or march to the Med 3-4 APC meeting to propose ideas.
